title: 01. Foundations: What is Artificial Intelligence & Generative AI?
summary: AI is making computers smart enough to do things that normally require human intelligence.

sections.title: 1.1 What is Artificial Intelligence (AI)?
sections.body:
### Simple Definition
> **AI is making computers smart enough to do things that normally require human intelligence.**

### Real-World Analogy
Think of it like teaching a child:
- You show the child 1000 pictures of cats and dogs
- The child learns patterns (cats have whiskers, dogs have floppy ears)
- Now the child can **identify** a new cat or dog they've never seen before

That's exactly what AI does — **it learns patterns from data and uses them to make decisions.**

### Types of AI (Simple View)

| Type | What It Does | Example |
|------|-------------|---------|
| **Traditional AI** | Follows strict rules written by humans | Chess game rules |
| **Machine Learning** | Learns patterns from data | Email spam filter |
| **Deep Learning** | Uses brain-like neural networks | Face recognition |
| **Generative AI** | Creates new content | ChatGPT, DALL-E |

sections.title: 1.2 What is Generative AI?
sections.body:
### Simple Definition
> **Generative AI is AI that can CREATE new content — text, images, audio, video, code — that never existed before.**

### Key Word: "GENERATE"
- Traditional AI: **Analyzes** existing data → gives a YES/NO or a category
- Generative AI: **Creates** brand new content → gives you something NEW

### Everyday Analogy
| Traditional AI | Generative AI |
|---------------|---------------|
| A judge who reads essays and gives grades (A, B, C) | A writer who actually **writes** the essay for you |
| A doctor who looks at an X-ray and says "broken" or "not broken" | A doctor who **describes** the full diagnosis report in plain English |

### What Can Generative AI Create?

```
📝 TEXT       → Articles, emails, code, summaries, translations
🎨 IMAGES     → Realistic photos, artwork, logos (DALL-E, Midjourney)
🎵 AUDIO      → Music, voiceovers, sound effects
🎬 VIDEO      → Short clips, animations (Sora, Runway)
💻 CODE       → Python scripts, web apps, SQL queries (GitHub Copilot)
```

### Famous Generative AI Tools
- **ChatGPT / GPT-4** → Text generation
- **Claude** → Text generation
- **Gemini** → Text + Images
- **DALL-E / Midjourney / Stable Diffusion** → Image generation
- **GitHub Copilot** → Code generation
- **Sora** → Video generation
